cohort: Use all pre-registered 6+19 exposed frames and 9 separately registered held frames. No calls to Astra. Labels, future recording, offline visual review and expert paths are not inputs. 1062 is a development frame and the earlier failures (left edge crossing; right trajectories reduce predicted object clearance) are known.
method: Refit controls against the actual final native body trajectory. Transfer the frozen reference clearance floor for predicted bodies into the search, and request greater predicted physical edge clearance. Preserve the original release audits including all retained object modes, primary and secondary measured road, original CAN steering and learned/smooth rectangle budgets. Use no new geometry source. Models do not select new regions.
seeds: Use at most two distinct saved seeds with their own bounded corridor: (1) nearest old eligible candidate to native over six future BODY knots, else least deviation of any numeric candidate; (2) best positive primary predicted road minimum sampled distance of all numerical audited seeds, then minimum native deviation. Ties stable by name. Warm starts can be rejected; every new return receives independent verification. Old empty/no eligible distinction preserved.
geometry: For each seed use observed nearest local edge segments beside its BODY and closest predicted rectangle modes in the current scene. At 0.125 s samples impose projections against seed-based separating directions for nearby modes and edge segments. Target physical-boundary clearance 0.40, 0.65, 0.90 m, ramped across first 0.75 s from min(target, initial edge clearance). Object floor from frozen knot/dense record, plus small interior pad for moving times. Preserve original release even when seed-based planes simplify evaluation.
optimization: Each seed/margin one 24-control SLSQP, max 75 iterations; fixed existing corridors, same original dynamics, no cap removal. Minimize BODY knot squared error to native at positive times with smooth acceleration/steering regularization, no GT. Save failed and eligible candidates. Maximum six solves/frame.
decision: Only replace a native path with an independently verified new path if native predicted edge trigger is active and candidate increases swept edge clearance at least 0.10m. Among alternatives clearing native trigger choose nearest native six-body-knots squared distance; otherwise select largest achieved edge clearance (then path deviation, then method). No new certified alternative or native never triggered -> explicitly retained native without new certificate. Union with old menu only in a separately labelled analysis; this method tests the new search itself.
limitation: The curb margin sets are development proposals, not new safety guarantees. Final road/object and task provenance/constraints use the frozen learned-world audits. Comparing prior-policy-vs-native does not prove new Astra goals or native safe.
